definition: a formal event on a special occasion
description: A large tatami room with sliding paper screens, a hanging scroll in the alcove and two rows of people in dark suits kneeling along the side walls. A tall young man in a dark suit and an older woman in a black kimono stand facing each other down the middle of the mats, a white certificate laid on the floor between them. They bow to each other from the waist, then bow again lower, then kneel down on the mats on either side of the certificate. In the last shot both are pressed right down with their foreheads almost on the tatami over the paper.

en.question: What are the man and woman doing?

de.question: Was machen der Mann und die Frau?

es.answer: Se están haciendo una reverencia el uno al otro.
es.question: ¿Qué están haciendo el hombre y la mujer?
